distinct_body: The Founders Organization is separate from The .LLab. It is how companies partner with The Co.LLab™: their participation provides the capital and support to build Leadership Infrastructure™, and that value moves back through the Omnidirectional Enterprise™ ecosystem — connecting companies, creators, organizations, nonprofits, communities, intellectual property, opportunity, and legacy.
phases_eyebrow: The Four Phases of Leadership Infrastructure™

phases.title: Foundations
phases.description: Founder participation lays the foundation — the capital and support that let The Co.LLab™ build Leadership Infrastructure™ around human potential.

phases.title: Infrastructure Planning & Management
phases.description: That support is directed into the infrastructure the Omnidirectional Enterprise™ needs — and how companies, creators, organizations, and communities connect to it.

phases.title: Internal Operating Systems
phases.description: The systems, tools, and frameworks built from that support serve the whole ecosystem, moving value in multiple directions.

phases.title: Preservation
phases.description: Value returns through the Omnidirectional Enterprise™ — to companies, creators, nonprofits, communities, intellectual property, opportunity, and lasting legacy.

apply_body: Each founding option provides capital and support to build The Co.LLab™ and its Leadership Infrastructure™ — value that moves back through the Omnidirectional Enterprise™ ecosystem.

tiers.description: Your entry into the Omnidirectional Enterprise™. Your purchase becomes revenue that builds The Co.LLab™'s Leadership Infrastructure™ — and flows back out to creators, organizations, nonprofits, and communities.

A larger contribution to the flow. Your purchase builds The Co.LLab™'s Leadership Infrastructure™ and moves further through the Omnidirectional Enterprise™ — connecting companies, creators, nonprofits, and communities.
Founding participation in the Founders Organization — providing capital and support to build The Co.LLab™ and its Leadership Infrastructure™.
Founding participation at the highest contribution level — supporting the development and preservation of Leadership Infrastructure™ across the Omnidirectional Enterprise™.

founder_benefits: Every founding option includes a permanent Founder Number, a digital Founder Card, and 20% off eligible future products from The Co.LLab™ while signed in.
founder_not_investment: Founding options are purchases, not investments. They carry no ownership stake and no financial return.
recognition_body: Founder participation supports The Co.LLab™'s Omnidirectional Enterprise™ model — where value, authority, intelligence, IP, and opportunity move in multiple directions, not purely top-down. Founders help strengthen Leadership Infrastructure™ and the ecosystem connecting creators, businesses, nonprofits, organizations, and enterprise — turning human potential into performance, sustainable enterprise value, and lasting legacy.
recognition_empty: Founder Numbers are issued the moment a Founder purchase completes — check back soon.
